newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Stals sees no current need for rate hike.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Stals sees no current need for rate hike.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said on Tuesday he did not see an immediate need for a Bank rate hike despite pressure in the banking system.
"We just do not at this stage feel it is necessary to increase the bank rate right now," he told reporters at the bank's annual meeting.
South Africa's Bank rate currently stands at 16.0 percent.
